tasks.title: We know whether level 1's laser columns kill AI enemies today, and if they do, enemies now steer round them
tasks.description: Per plan §2.16. (1) Expose level 1's column schedule as data: level_1_director.gd gains static func laser_column_schedule() -> Dictionary and a pure _build_schedules() that _ready() uses, behaviour identical; a cheap row in the new tests/integration/test_level1_laser_columns.gd checks the schedule equals the bound arguments of the director's _spawn_laser_columns callables. (2) Measure, with a kept but manually-run helper (tests/helpers/level1_column_replay.gd, no test_ prefix, plus scripts/measure-level1-columns.sh), how many AI enemies die in level 1's LaserRay columns and LaserWallWave per section and per kind (real WaveManager + the column schedule, 8× clock). Record the pre-placement counts in DECISIONS.md. (3) If any die: add an opt-in registers_hazard export to LaserRay (default false; race and station unaffected) registering a &"laser_wall" segment from warn start to the end of active, turn it on for level 1's columns and LaserWallWave, add the registration rows and re-measure; every level-1 gate must stay green unchanged, else the pre-approved lever applies (leave it off in level 1 and hand the finding to Ph15). (4) If none die, change nothing else and hand the question to Ph15. This task runs before the level-1 placement task, which reads laser_column_schedule() and re-runs the measurement with the Ph8 spawns. Gate time: allotment 0.3 s of new GUT time (the allotment line in "For every task" and plan §2.20); report scripts/gate-time.sh before/after in the task report and tests/README.md → Gate time.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- laser_column_schedule() exists, matches the director's schedule (row green), and the level plays identically.
- The helper and script exist and run headless; the measured counts per section and kind are in DECISIONS.md.
- If LaserRay changed: default behaviour byte-identical (test_laser_ray_hit_mask.gd, test_station_laser_phase.gd and race tests unchanged and green), registration rows pass, level-1 gates green.
- verify.sh green; GUT within allotment.

tasks.title: The hub has a defended derelict site to assault, plus a Laser Tender and a twin-drone pair on patrol, without crowding the player's spawn or the mission planets
tasks.description: Per plan §2.17: build assault/scenes/structures/turret_group/presets/hub_defense_site.tscn (heavy emplacement, sweep, rocket battery and lance turrets, shield generator, power source, a CYCLE laser fence; coverage_radius 450, passing the group coverage row) and instance it under EnemyContainer near the TacticalSpace derelicts (origin ≈ (2520, 1040)); add the Laser Tender as patrol draw 16 and a standalone TwinLaserPairSpawn as draw 17 (every earlier seed unchanged). Extend test_sector_hub_patrol.gd: _patrol_groups() gains both patrols; new sweep A (test_hub_defense_site_reach_clears_spawn_triggers_and_pickups) walks EnemyContainer's TurretGroup / LaserFence children and checks each one's fire reach (max over slots of |offset| + max(perceive_radius, largest mount range); 1360 px for the site) clears the player spawn, every MissionTrigger and every PickupBase; new sweep B (test_hub_patrols_clear_the_defense_site) checks every patrol group, existing and new, keeps its idle ring clear of the site's footprint (|offset| + body radius, + fence half length, + 100 px) — not its fire reach; each sweep has a rejecting boundary. Seed / composition / frame-0 IDLE / site rows (members in EnemyContainer, powered, the five BaseEnemy members shielded, fence posts not) and a hub frame-time note with and without the site. Use the pre-approved lever (move the site origin to a clear point on a 3000 px ring) if an existing hub row turns red, and record it. Gate time: allotment 1.2 s of new GUT time (the allotment line in "For every task" and plan §2.20); report scripts/gate-time.sh before/after in the task report and tests/README.md → Gate time.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- Hub rows pass, including sweeps A and B with rejecting boundaries; draws 1–15 unchanged.
- The site spawns powered members into EnemyContainer, shielded except the fence posts.
- verify.sh green; GUT within allotment.

tasks.title: Level 1 sends a two-turret group and a twin-drone pair through Deep Space and a Laser Tender through Planet Approach without crowding the level or holding a section open
tasks.description: Per plan §2.18. Recompute the alive curves through the gate's own code and print them before editing the director. Place, inside existing waves (no new wave, no rail): b.turret_group(WaveBuilder.TURRET_GROUP_ASSAULT_PAIR).at(-64, -220) in deep_space's 3.0 s wave (effective 3.5 s; world-anchored, members at world x 462 / 512 / 562), b.twin_laser_pair().at(-250, -220) in deep_space's 29.0 s wave, and b.laser_tender().at(-300, -200) in planet_approach's 2.0 s wave. Extend test_level1_specialist_spawns.gd: EXPECTED_PH8 pin rows; every member / drone / tender counted in the frozen 2.5× gate with the worst-case drift life (≤ 28.1 s from the highest spawn to projectile_world_rect().end.y at 60 px/s), the drone and tender lives with the deferral and launch-time bounds of §2.12 / §2.13 and the exits from tests/helpers/ph8_exit_keys.gd (memo hits: no new probe); test_ph8_static_members_clear_every_lit_column (every static member vs every column in Level1Director.laser_column_schedule() lit during its life, |x − column| ≥ 28 + body radius; revision 1's (0, −220) fails it); spill-over row. Extend test_engagement_deadline.gd (no ENEMIES_CLEARED section holds a turret group, laser fence, twin pair or tender, with detection and boundary rows). Add attack-in-budget slice replays (16× only for clock-bound rows): the 29.0 s pair reaches ADVANCE once, the tender reaches LAUNCH and its pair ADVANCE, both turrets fire while in view; member departure is checked analytically. Re-run scripts/measure-level1-columns.sh with the Ph8 spawns in and record the counts in DECISIONS.md. Use the pre-approved levers of §2.18 in order if a row turns red (tender then drone engage_seconds 10 → 6 / 8 → 6 while the attack rows stay green; move the pair; drop the ring turret); never move a bound. Gate time: allotment 3.5 s of new GUT time (the allotment line in "For every task" and plan §2.20); report scripts/gate-time.sh before/after in the task report and tests/README.md → Gate time.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria:
- deep_space peak ≤ 12.5 (expected 12 at 29.0–31.6 s) and planet_approach ≤ 7.5 (expected ≤ 7 at 28.4–32.0 s; the drones gone by 32.0 s); curves printed.
- The column-clearance row passes and fails on the revision-1 placement.
- No Ph8 spawn in an ENEMIES_CLEARED section; spill-over row green.
- Attack-in-budget rows pass from every Ph8 level-1 spawn.
- The post-placement column counts are in DECISIONS.md.
- All existing level-1 gates green; verify.sh green; GUT within allotment.
